lines.text: Every patch is measured as φ, a vector of what you hear.
Switch to PERFORM, and the controls are named for what you hear.
Each control reaches the knobs through its measured Jacobian.
The model keeps a posterior over your taste, and it sharpens with every vote.
Auracle is built on quiver, a patch-graph engine, and fugue, a library for inference.
It runs in your browser as WASM, and it plays from any MIDI keyboard.
Every sound is a point in a 44-dimensional space of what you hear.
Auracle's taste model is a Bayesian posterior over φ.
